stem: A sticky card in one corner has a sharp increase in captures while cards elsewhere remain near baseline. What should the technician do?
choices: Map and document the localized increase, inspect the nearby crop and entry pathways, and escalate according to the scouting procedure
Replace every card and discard the counts
Assume the entire facility has the same pest pressure
Apply a treatment without identifying the finding
rationale: A localized trap increase is useful spatial evidence. It should trigger focused inspection and documented escalation, not an unsupported facility-wide conclusion.
